review.source_gold_method: Manual source judgments from raw bytes and explicit import/base witnesses before any producer run; Python stdlib byte lookup computes independently selected regions.

range_convention.bytes: zero-based half-open UTF-8 byte offsets in original source bytes
range_convention.lines: one-based; end_line contains the last included byte
range_convention.columns: zero-based UTF-8 byte columns, not codepoint or UTF-16 positions
range_convention.declarations: start at class/def token; exclude decorator and trailing newline/whitespace; decoration witnesses remain explicit unknowns

synthetic_identity_boundary: Framework stand-ins are fixed fixture bytes, never executed and not real Django. Real corpus identity requires the pinned source anchors; spelling a module django is insufficient without an admitted source/dependency identity.

corrective_pass.blocking_review: B1 finite source/import admission; B2 observable unknown rows; B3 malformed callback control

context_field_shapes.enabled: explicit boolean true for framework analysis

source_admission.production_boundary: Trusted caller/configuration explicitly registers dependency identity and source-root ownership in the existing structural owner. Production context contains no oracle case IDs, gold target facts, gold ranges or gold file hashes. Actual inventory source digests are freshness/integrity evidence, never an oracle used to choose targets. Synthetic identity is test-only and never evidence of real Django.
source_admission.mutation_context: Each synthetic phase replaces the context revision with its frozen result_inventory_sha256; provider logical identity/root remain explicit. Gold after_sha256 is a test input digest, not a production identity recognizer.
source_admission.module_to_physical_path: Only the registered django prefix maps within its one admitted source root. Each module is selected from exactly stem.py and stem/__init__.py, independently of export presence. Zero candidates is missing; multiple candidates is unknown, with no runtime precedence choice.
source_admission.parent_initializers: Every candidate and parent initializer lookup, including absence, is observed. Complete initializer bytes are witnesses, never executed. The finite Django chain requires one canonical parent package, non-partial initializer evidence and no explicit rebinding of the next namespace segment. Namespace absence is allowed only for the declared source-root-relative callback directory model; it does not authorize Python runtime packaging.
source_admission.callback_policy: Use existing shared Python relative-symbol resolution for from .views import name and stable local aliases. Preserve its existing module alternatives, partial/multiplicity/decorator/initializer restrictions. General absolute callbacks, import_statement callbacks, arbitrary reexports and from . import views package-attribute dispatch remain unsupported; no root/name fallback.
source_admission.framework_api_policy: Retain raw import_statement/import-from, alias, base, callback, decorator and class/local-hook ownership seeds during the existing one-tree collection. An opt-in registration-only branch in the shared resolver may use the finite dependency context, canonical module witnesses and the four allowed facade edges to qualify API identity. conf.path/re_path partial assignments are API registration witnesses, not ordinary function declarations or _path lexical targets. No general absolute import or reexport support is added.

allowed_facade_edges.pinned_guard: the explicit final Manager import follows earlier wildcard imports; no later explicit Manager rebinding; no generic wildcard resolution

allowed_facade_edges.guard: complete non-partial db initializer has no explicit models value binding; one canonical models package; this is a finite submodule witness, not initializer execution

rejection_policy.zero_candidates: source-backed unknown boundary with zero targets when an explicit candidate import witness exists
rejection_policy.multiple_candidates: source-backed unknown boundary with zero targets; candidate target enumeration not required
rejection_policy.partial_importer_or_dependency: withhold identity and all target bindings depending on the partial file; retain partial-role/source-digest evidence and an unknown boundary
rejection_policy.shadowed_conditional_or_decorated: unknown boundary, zero targets, no identity-decorator or runtime last-binding exemption
rejection_policy.missing_or_conflicting_context: no qualified identity; observable bounded framework-unqualified result and candidate boundary rows only from retained explicit source witnesses
rejection_policy.unsupported_environment: sys.path, installed package/version inference, import hooks, active builds, arbitrary roots, dynamic reexports or initialization are unqualified
rejection_policy.disabled_context: ordinary structural behavior unchanged; explicitly requested framework analysis reports unavailable coverage, not complete absence

source_admission.owner_requirement: Same FileFacts/CollectedFile strict typed handoff, shared resolver, StructuralIndex transaction/generations and SQLSnapshot/Queries. Observe positive/negative candidate, initializer, export and configuration lookups; charge retained seeds/facts/text in serial and queued admission. No second parser, scan, resolver or graph. Ordinary lexical calls/import projections are unchanged.
